metadata.title: त्रिपुरा की पहाड़ियों में कैसे जी रहे हैं आदिवासी | How tribal survive hills of Tripura
metadata.description:
In this eye-opening ground report, we delve deep into the heart of Tripura, a state with a significant tribal population residing in its hilly areas. Join us as we shine a light on the unfortunate reality faced by these tribal communities in the modern age, where their villages remain disconnected from the mainstream.

In this compelling video, witness firsthand the harsh conditions endured by the tribal people, as they rely on rivers and streams for their daily water needs. We bring you exclusive interviews and stories from the heart of these communities, revealing their ongoing struggle for clean drinking water.

Through stunning visuals and powerful narratives, we expose the challenges faced by the tribes in accessing safe and potable water sources. Discover the daily hardships they endure and the impact it has on their health and well-being.

Join us as we shed light on this important issue and raise awareness about the urgent need for sustainable solutions. Together, let's work towards ensuring that every individual, regardless of their background, has access to clean water—a fundamental right that no one should be deprived of.

Don't miss this thought-provoking video as we uncover the untold stories and give voice to those who have long been unheard. Like, share, and subscribe to support our efforts in making a positive change in the lives of Tripura's tribal communities.
